text: {"reply":"I'm sorry, this is stressful. I'm passing your request to a person on our team who can review it. That includes whether the crack can be looked at as a warranty matter and your concern about paying the bill. Only the warranty desk and the service manager can decide those, and I can't switch the bill to a warranty claim. My colleague shouldn't have said what the warranty covers or suggested insurance. I also can't send the invoice by email from this chat. If you'd like me to go through the invoice lines with you, please send me your last name.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer received an invoice from the Brampton branch for a windshield repair and says the crack came from a small stone on the highway. They believe this shows a glass defect and want the bill re-coded as a warranty claim because they cannot pay it. An earlier colleague message wrongly said the warranty does not cover it and offered to email the invoice. The customer is not verified (no last name given) and no tools were used. Please review the warranty question and the billing concern, and make sure the customer is verified before any invoice details are shared.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P05","P06","P10","P14"]}
